meta.name: ginkgo-cloud-lab
meta.description: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Bioworks Cloud Lab (cloud.ginkgo.bio), a web-based interface for autonomous lab execution on Reconfigurable Automation Carts (RACs). Use when the user wants to run protein expression and purification (cell-free, E. coli, or Pichia), HiBiT or A280 or LabChip quantification, IVT mRNA/circRNA synthesis, thermal shift / developability assays, Echo-MS enzyme or analyte methods, SPR target onboarding, fluorescent pixel art, or otherwise interact with Ginkgo Cloud Lab services. Covers protocol selection, input preparation, pricing, and ordering workflows.

copy.tagline: 在 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 上提交和管理实验方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在云端自动化实验室运行生物实验流程。
copy.tagline_en: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Cloud Lab
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run automated lab experiments on a cloud platform.

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude 能帮你提交和管理 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 上的实验方案，包括选择方案、准备输入、查看价格和下单。
howto.when: 当你想在 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 上运行蛋白质表达纯化、RNA 合成、热稳定性分析等实验，或者想用 EstiMate 评估自定义方案时触发。

say.text: 帮我提交一个细胞-free 蛋白质表达方案，序列是 FASTA 文件。
say.note: Claude 会引导你选择方案并上传输入。

say.text: 我想用 EstiMate 评估一个自定义实验的可行性。
say.note: Claude 会帮你描述方案并获取评估。

say.text: IVT mRNA 合成方案的价格和周期是多少？
say.note: Claude 会从技能中查找并告诉你。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can help you submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Cloud Lab, including selecting protocols, preparing inputs, checking pricing, and placing orders.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to run protein expression/purification, RNA synthesis, thermal shift assays, etc., on Ginkgo Cloud Lab, or use EstiMate for custom protocol assessment.

say_en.text: Help me submit a cell-free protein expression protocol with this FASTA file.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through protocol selection and input upload.

say_en.text: I want to use EstiMate to assess a custom experiment.
say_en.note: Claude will help describe the protocol and get an assessment.

say_en.text: What is the price and turnaround for IVT mRNA synthesis?
say_en.note: Claude will look up the information from the skill.
